item.title: Launch HN: Expanse (YC P26) – Unlock Wasted GPU Capacity
item.description:
📝 It ingests live hardware telemetry (DCGM, CUPTI, Cgroups, Network/IO monitoring) of your cluster creating a custom embedding of how your hardware performs. We fine tune cluster-specific models that get sharper over time as you run more workloads. From these predictions we also surface failure predictions for OOMs and other memory related issues, and code line level optimisations to increase the utilisation of the job on the hardware.
